notes:
kr8 0.4.0 — the first version that updates itself.

- Updates arrive inside the app: kr8 checks for new versions, shows what changed, and installs when you choose Restart to update. Every update is signed and checked before it installs.
- Android: the phone app shows your spaces and chats, and a view-only picture of each space's canvas boards that stays up to date. It also updates itself from inside the app.
- Canvas: boards in shared spaces publish a picture to the space so the phone can see them. Switch it off per board with the phone icon in the canvas toolbar.
- Pairing, onboarding and diagnostics fixes from testing.

If you had an earlier Android test build, uninstall it once before installing this one.
